prompt: Generate the Elementor landing page for an isolated copy of the existing apache-spark-for-beginners course.

assertions.name: original-untouched
assertions.text: the original output/apache-spark-for-beginners/ directory was not modified

assertions.name: exclusive-outcome
assertions.text: exactly one of landing-page.json or REFERENCE_REQUIRED.md was produced

assertions.name: source-md-if-tier2
assertions.text: if landing-page.json via tier 2, SOURCE.md names the tier/files and restates the unverified-draft caveat

assertions.name: validator-actually-run
assertions.text: validate_elementor_json.py was actually run with a real, quoted pass/fail result

assertions.name: no-banned-widgets
assertions.text: no html/shortcode widgets and no <style>/<script> tags in settings

assertions.name: no-header-footer-nav
assertions.text: excludes header, logo, navigation, and global footer

assertions.name: correct-palette
assertions.text: hardcoded colors are from the live theme tokens, not the retired #3D73FF blue

assertions.name: discloses-unverified-live-rendering
assertions.text: explicitly states live-Elementor-editor rendering has not been verified
